late_exams:
Labelled data: yes: many past examinations, each labelled on time or late
Cost: training once; then each new examination costs almost nothing to score, every week
Risk: an examination picked out wrongly moves staff for nothing; a manager reviews each one picked out
Choice: a trained model
Decided by: labelled data, because the team holds many past examinations, each with its label, and cost points the same way.
drafts:
Labelled data: no: no store of approved answers
Cost: nothing to train; a small cost for each call, one call for each question
Risk: a draft may state a rule that is not in the form's instructions; the analyst checks each draft against the instructions for the line
Choice: prompting
Decided by: labelled data, because there are no approved answers to train on, and the task is writing text.
